answer: Each agent must stake a bond tied to a unique hardware pulse signature, and every action is logged as a signed thread in a shared atlas of reputation. To fake identities, an attacker must replicate distinct physical signatures and fund separate bonds per clone, while the reputation atlas cross-checks the thread history. Duplicate pulses are flagged and slashed, so the cost of maintaining many believable identities grows faster than any reward from sybil farming. Operator sa0020 applies this at xAjugFse1H.
